selected_primary_model.name: RF_Tuned (Tuned Random Forest)
selected_primary_model.justification: Highest non-linear PR-AUC, highest ROC-AUC, lowest cross-fold variance (std=0.0226), and natural resistance to monotonic scaling.

modeling_and_imbalance.imbalanced_learning_finding: Synthetic oversampling (SMOTE) degraded PR-AUC from 0.2316 to 0.1966 in Random Forest due to synthetic noise along overlapping continuous decision boundaries. Post-hoc probability calibration and algorithmic threshold tuning vastly outperform resampling.

selected_method.justification: Sigmoid scaling improved Brier score (0.1027 vs 0.1030) and Log Loss (0.3531 vs 0.3545) while exhibiting lowest cross-fold variance. Isotonic regression suffered from step-function discretization plateaus and higher out-of-fold variance on sparse fraud cases.

explainability_and_attributions.technical_boundary_distinction: TreeSHAP explains additive log-odds of the base Random Forest estimator. Calibrated probabilities represent a monotonic Platt sigmoid mapping sigma(A*f(x) + B). SHAP values are not claimed to decompose calibrated probabilities additively.

most_damaging_scenario.name: Scenario 3: Velocity Surge
most_damaging_scenario.mitigation: Dynamic promotional velocity normalization & rate limiting.

most_resilient_domains: Numerical missingness (+20% nulls): handled seamlessly by median imputer + indicators (W1 = 0.0025).
Unseen categorical drift: safely ignored by OneHotEncoder with zero execution errors (W1 = 0.0010).

policy.intended_use: Automated payment risk triage for retail e-commerce and card-not-present transactions. Routes transactions into APPROVE (p < 0.10), MANUAL REVIEW (0.10 <= p < 0.36), and BLOCK (p >= 0.36).
policy.prohibited_use: Credit scoring, creditworthiness evaluations, automated employment background screening, tenant vetting, or legal jurisdiction profiling. Disallowed under ECOA and FCRA.
policy.dataset_assumptions: Cross-sectional transaction snapshot with 12.13% historical fraud prevalence. Predictors represent telemetry available strictly at authorization time.
policy.prediction_time_availability: Strict isolation: transaction_id and fraud target are quarantined. All 23 predictors must be populated from authorization stream telemetry.
policy.target_leakage_mitigation: Zero post-transaction settlement or chargeback feedback variables are permitted into the feature matrix. Prior chargebacks represent historical merchant records, not current transaction outcomes.
policy.temporal_limitations: Only hour and day_of_week are provided; full chronological timestamps are unavailable. Stratified random partitioning is utilized; chronological time-based drift models require future timestamp logging.
policy.monitoring_frequency: Daily score distributions; weekly drift sweeps; monthly retraining reviews.

monitoring_metrics.measurement_definition: Wasserstein distance (Earth Mover's Distance) between daily score distribution and baseline policy validation distribution.
monitoring_metrics.required_data: Daily inference log of calibrated fraud probabilities.
monitoring_metrics.proposed_trigger: Wasserstein distance > 0.05 or median probability shifts by > 0.03.
monitoring_metrics.recommended_response: Trigger MLOps investigation; verify upstream merchant telemetry; inspect feature distributions.

monitoring_metrics.measurement_definition: Population Stability Index (PSI) on top 5 global predictors (e.g. combined_merchant_ip_risk, login_velocity_interaction).
monitoring_metrics.required_data: Raw transaction feature telemetry from authorization stream.
monitoring_metrics.proposed_trigger: PSI > 0.20 on any top-5 feature (significant distributional shift).
monitoring_metrics.recommended_response: Audit feature pipelines; verify upstream risk score vendor feeds; check for holiday/promotional velocity surges.

monitoring_metrics.measurement_definition: Percentage of missing values in core telemetry fields (authentication_level, merchant_risk_score, ip_risk_score).
monitoring_metrics.proposed_trigger: Missingness > 25% in authentication_level or > 10% in risk score feeds.
monitoring_metrics.recommended_response: Raise Sev-2 telemetry degradation alert; inspect mobile app/web SDK network timeouts; verify API vendor uptime.

monitoring_metrics.measurement_definition: True positive capture rate based on 30-to-60 day confirmed chargeback and manual review clearance records.
monitoring_metrics.required_data: Historical authorization logs joined with settled dispute records.
monitoring_metrics.proposed_trigger: Realized fraud capture rate drops below 60.0% (baseline: 69.86%).
monitoring_metrics.recommended_response: Initiate immediate model retraining cycle; re-optimize operational decision thresholds; review evasion patterns.

monitoring_metrics.measurement_definition: Rate of legitimate transactions incorrectly hard-blocked relative to total volume.
monitoring_metrics.required_data: Customer support dispute logs, chargeback clearance logs, and automated block logs.
monitoring_metrics.proposed_trigger: False hard block rate exceeds 1.5% of legitimate volume (baseline: 0.57%).
monitoring_metrics.recommended_response: Elevate block_threshold (e.g. from 0.36 to 0.42); route borderline cases to manual review; audit top fraud rules.

monitoring_metrics.measurement_definition: Empirical Brier score and Expected Calibration Error (ECE) on confirmed historical transaction cohorts.
monitoring_metrics.required_data: Monthly settled transaction outcomes and logged calibrated probabilities.
monitoring_metrics.recommended_response: Refit CalibratedClassifierCV calibrator on recent 90-day settled development window; verify Platt scaling parameters.

monitoring_metrics.measurement_definition: Percentage of total transaction volume routed to human investigator queues.
monitoring_metrics.required_data: Real-time decision engine transaction routing logs.
monitoring_metrics.proposed_trigger: Manual review demand exceeds 65.0% of total volume or investigator queue latency exceeds SLA (e.g. > 15 minutes).
monitoring_metrics.recommended_response: Engage adaptive capacity throttling (raise review_threshold from 0.10 to 0.15); route lowest-risk review band to passive step-up auth.

monitoring_metrics.measurement_definition: Realized financial cost units (CU) per 1k transactions combining fraud loss, review wages, and customer friction.
monitoring_metrics.proposed_trigger: Cost per 1k transactions exceeds 14,000 CU (baseline: 11,100 CU; a >25% inflation shock).
monitoring_metrics.recommended_response: Executive review of cost parameters; investigate sudden large-amount fraud leakage; recalibrate 3-tier policy.

operational_lifecycle.investigate_drift: Triggered when daily Wasserstein score drift exceeds 0.05 or weekly feature PSI exceeds 0.20. MLOps reviews data feeds without halting inference.
operational_lifecycle.review_thresholds: Triggered when review queue congestion exceeds 65% capacity or confirmed false block rate exceeds 1.5%. Risk committee adjusts review_threshold or block_threshold within approved bounds.
operational_lifecycle.retrain_model: Triggered quarterly as standard maintenance, or ad-hoc if 60-day confirmed fraud recall drops below 60.0% or Brier score exceeds 0.120. Retraining must follow frozen pipeline CV protocols.
operational_lifecycle.rollback_to_prior_version: Triggered if new model deployment exhibits unexpected runtime error rate > 0.1%, severe calibration degradation (ECE > 0.05), or severe unexplained drop in fraud capture within first 48 hours.
operational_lifecycle.temporarily_disable_automated_blocking: OPERATIONAL KILL SWITCH: If incoming telemetry experiences systemic upstream failure (e.g. merchant risk score API down, missingness > 50%), automated BLOCK is immediately suspended (block_threshold set to 1.0). All suspect transactions are diverted to MANUAL REVIEW or step-up 3DS authentication to prevent widespread customer lockouts.
